name: bar-chart
title: Bar chart
description: Compare values across categories with vertical or horizontal bars, grouped or stacked.
a11y: The chart is role=img with the required title as its name.
A visually hidden table lists every value, one row per category, for screen readers.
One focusable stop per category with a spoken label; Arrow keys move between them and Escape hides the tooltip.
The value tooltip opens on hover and on keyboard focus.
Series differ by fill pattern as well as colour, and the legend names them.

props.name: title
props.description: Accessible name and table caption. Required.

props.name: series
props.description: Several series: `[{name: 'Visits', values: [3, 5]}]`, with `labels` for the categories.

props.name: labels
props.description: Category labels for the x axis (or y axis when horizontal), one per value in `series`.

props.name: seriesName
props.description: Name of the single series when `data` is used. Default "Value".

props.name: orientation
props.description: `vertical` draws columns, `horizontal` draws rows (better for long labels). Default `vertical`.

props.name: stacked
props.description: Stack series on top of each other instead of side by side.

props.name: showValues
props.description: Print each value at the end of its bar (the total for stacked bars).

props.name: height
props.description: Chart height in px. Horizontal charts size themselves to the number of rows when omitted. Default 280.

props.name: valueFormat
props.description: Format a value for labels, tooltips and the table.
